name: VEEM Ltd
summary: VEEM Ltd manufactures and sells propulsion and stabilization systems. It offers propellers, centrifugally cast hollow bars, and gyrostabilizers; and manufactures bespoke products and services to the marine, defense, and mining industries. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Canning Vale, Australia. VEEM Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Veem Corporation Pty Ltd.
